title: Marketplace onboarding playbook — scratch
content:
Quick personal scratchpad for partner marketplace onboarding work. Mix of notes, quick TODOs, and small playbook fragments I can copy into a proper doc later. Not polished — just my brain dump while juggling calls and smoke tests.

Top priority for today (sprint-ish):
- finish sandbox tenant provisioning for AcmeMarket (requested 10 seats, want to verify SSO + billing metering)
- unblock API key rotation issue with their devops (they're on a locked-down KMS)
- run smoke tests for embedding similarity and chat generation on a small corpus (see test vectors below)

Meeting notes 2026-03-11 11:00 — kickoff w/ AcmeMarket (S. Patel, H. Ortiz)
- goal: onboard pilot 2 customers in 2 weeks; need sample integration app + docs
- they want SSO via SAML; asked about SCIM? -> told them SCIM is optional for pilot, we'll circle back
- billing question: usage reported daily, invoiced monthly — confirm if their finance wants per-customer sub-billing (likely later)
- action: Priya to share sample SAML metadata by end of day Thu

Sandbox provisioning checklist (minimal for pilot):
[ ] create tenant + org in dedicated sandbox env (tag: acme-pilot-03)
[ ] generate service role + limited API key for their integration team
[ ] configure SAML endpoint and verify login flow (test 3 accounts)
[ ] enable embeddings route + chat-default model (gpt-like open model variant)
[ ] set quotas: 5 r/s, 20 concurrent tokens, 10k token/day initial cap
[ ] attach billing metadata + ledger id for metering (so finance can track usage)

API key rotation gotcha notes:
- they use a constrained KMS; can't just upload keys. Options:
  1) Redwood issues short-lived keys that they fetch via our STS flow — need an engineer to wire up OIDC trust (requires infra change request).
  2) Manual initial key + scheduled rotation window + partner rotates keys and informs us — lower dev friction but operational overhead.
Decision: propose option 1 for long term; for pilot do option 2 with strict expiry reminders.

Test vectors (quick, copy to CI later):
1) Embedding similarity: small corpus of 8 product docs (title + 200-400 char blurb). Query set: 6 user questions (edge cases: typo heavy, long multi-sentence). Expected: top-1 should be semantically correct >= 0.75 sim.
2) Chat generation: persona = product helpdesk agent. Prompt design: 4 seed turns, then 3 unseen queries. Check: no hallucinations about internal-only features; responses < 256 tokens.
3) Rate-limit stress: burst 50 reqs/s for 30s on embedding endpoint — ensure graceful 429s and retry-after header present.

Quick commands I've been relying on (local testing):
- curl POST /v1/tenants/{id}/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer <me>" -d '{"purpose":"sandbox-integ"}'
- python3 scripts/run_embedding_test.py --tenant acme-pilot-03 --vectors tests/acme_small.json
(note: these are ephemeral; add to repo when stable)

Open questions / parking lot:
- whether we should pre-bundle a small sample integration app (node + react) for partners -> pros: faster time-to-value; cons: maintenance. Leaning yes but keep minimal.
- telemetry: which events do we surface to partner dashboard for pilot? (initial thought: daily token usage, latency p95, error-rate)
- legal: do we need an addendum for pilot storage of sample customer data in sandbox? check with legal — send short note (Noah)

Priority ordering for today (timeboxed):
- 09:00-10:00 -> finish tenant + API key, smoke test basic flows
- 10:30-11:30 -> kickoff call + SAML metadata follow-up
- 13:00-15:00 -> run embedding + chat tests, collect metrics, capture failure cases
- 15:30-16:30 -> patch sample README + onboarding checklist for partner devs

Micro-reminders (to self):
- ping Priya if SAML metadata not in my inbox by 17:00 Thu
- put test failures in JIRA with tag "acme-pilot" not in payments queue
- record short Loom walkthrough for partner devs after sandbox is green

Fast links (copy-pastes I use):
- partner sandbox dashboard: https://console.redwood-inference.internal/sandbox/tenants/acme-pilot-03
- dev readme stub: github.com/redwood-inference/partner-samples/tree/main/acme-stub
- quick onboarding deck (slides): confluence.company.com/display/marketplace/Partner+Pilot+Playbook

Notes on tone for partner comms (short checklist):
- be pragmatic, not salesy — they want a working PoC fast
- surface limitations upfront (no SCIM for pilot, billing manual)
- tie success metrics to their customer activation numbers for first 30 days

End of scratch dump. Will trim and formalize into proper one-pager if the sandbox tests pass. If anything here seems critical, move to shared drive under shared_drives/company/misc or product docs so Ops can pick it up.


-- Sofia
(quick log: made progress on tenant creation 2026-03-11 09:40; ran embedding smoke test 09:58 — 2 false positives, need to tweak stop-words)
